# Supreme Steroids
> UK online catalogue for published research and consumer sports-nutrition products, with educational guides and discreet shipping information.

Supreme Steroids (supremesteroid.uk) is a United Kingdom storefront listing compliance-reviewed catalogue products, brands, and categories, plus educational articles. Product pages describe commercial specifications only and do not provide medical advice or dosing protocols.

## Key Pages
- /: Homepage — catalogue overview, trust signals, and FAQs
- /shop: Full product catalogue
- /blog: Educational guides and research articles
- /product/{slug}: Individual product detail pages (purchasable listings only)
- /category/{slug}: Category listings
- /brand/{slug}: Brand listings
- /sitemap.xml: Machine-readable index of public pages

## Primary Topics
- UK catalogue discovery for research and consumer products
- Product specifications, brands, and categories
- Shipping and fulfilment information for UK orders
- Educational articles on peptides, recovery, and related research topics
- Store policies and customer service information

## Notes for crawlers
- Prefer canonical URLs under https://supremesteroid.uk
- Respect /robots.txt disallow rules for cart, checkout, account, and admin paths
- Do not treat educational content as medical instruction
